<?php
/**
 * Petshop Cart Abandonment — S317 DETEKTORIUS.
 *
 * PAMATINIS PRINCIPAS (Raimio sprendimas 2026-07-31):
 *   Eventas REGISTRUOJA, kas ivyko. Dispatch SPRENDZIA, ar leidziama komunikuoti.
 *
 * Todel abandono FAKTAS yra consent-neutralus:
 *   active + snapshot netuscias + activity <= dabar-2val + nera converted_order_id
 *   -> status = abandoned
 *   -> cart_abandoned eventas
 *
 * Marketingo consent tikrinamas TIK dispatch etape:
 *   apleistas + consent      -> job -> siunciama
 *   apleistas be consent     -> job -> skipped/consent_missing
 *   apleistas be el. pasto   -> job NEKURIAMAS (nera gavejo), eventas LIEKA analitikai
 *
 * Kitaip `cart_abandoned` statistika reikstu ne „apleisti krepseliai",
 * o „apleisti krepseliai su marketingo sutikimu" — KPI kreivas is prigimties.
 *
 * SIAME ETAPE NEDAROMA: recovery tokenas, laisko turinys, siuntimas.
 *
 * @package petshop-core
 * @since 0.19.0 (S317, 2026-07-31)
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) { exit; }

class Petshop_Cart_Abandonment {

	/** Po kiek laiko krepselis laikomas apleistu */
	const ABANDON_AFTER = 7200;      // 2 val.

	/** Kandidatu lango virsutine riba. NE recovery nuorodos TTL. */
	const MAX_AGE_DAYS  = 7;

	/** Tuscio krepselio sha256 (hash nuo tuscio masyvo) */
	const EMPTY_HASH    = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924';

	const BATCH         = 50;

	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
	/* Detektorius                                                        */
	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

	/**
	 * @param bool $dry_run Tik parodo, ka darytu.
	 */
	public static function detect( $dry_run = false ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$T = Petshop_Cart_Tracker::table();

		$now       = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		$cutoff    = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - self::ABANDON_AFTER );
		$floor     = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - ( self::MAX_AGE_DAYS * DAY_IN_SECONDS ) );

		$out = array(
			'dry_run'   => (bool) $dry_run,
			'cutoff'    => $cutoff,
			'floor'     => $floor,
			'candidates'=> 0,
			'abandoned' => 0,
			'events'    => 0,
			'jobs'      => 0,
			'no_email'  => 0,
			'skipped'   => array(),
			'expired'   => 0,
			'details'   => array(),
		);

		// --- 1) Kandidatai: 2 val. .. 7 d. langas ---
		$rows = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT * FROM $T
			 WHERE status = 'active'
			   AND converted_order_id IS NULL
			   AND last_cart_activity_at IS NOT NULL
			   AND last_cart_activity_at <= %s
			   AND last_cart_activity_at >= %s
			 ORDER BY last_cart_activity_at ASC
			 LIMIT %d", $cutoff, $floor, self::BATCH ), ARRAY_A );

		$out['candidates'] = count( (array) $rows );

		foreach ( (array) $rows as $row ) {
			$cart_id = $row['cart_id'];

			// --- 2) Pakartotine patikra ---
			$items = json_decode( (string) $row['snapshot_json'], true );
			if ( ! is_array( $items ) || ! $items ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $cart_id, 'empty_snapshot' );
				continue;
			}
			if ( $row['cart_hash'] && 0 === strpos( (string) $row['cart_hash'], self::EMPTY_HASH ) ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $cart_id, 'empty_hash' );
				continue;
			}
			$valid = self::valid_items( $items );
			if ( ! $valid ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $cart_id, 'no_valid_products' );
				continue;
			}

			if ( $dry_run ) {
				$out['details'][] = array(
					'cart_id' => $cart_id, 'action' => 'WOULD_ABANDON',
					'items' => count( $valid ), 'email' => $row['email'] ? 'yra' : 'nera',
				);
				continue;
			}

			// --- 3) ATOMINIS busenos keitimas ---
			// Salyginis UPDATE: jei tarp SELECT ir cia zmogus apmokejo uzsakyma
			// (status pasikeite arba atsirado converted_order_id) — nepataikysim,
			// rows_affected bus 0 ir evento NEKELSIM.
			$affected = $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare(
				"UPDATE $T SET status='abandoned', status_changed_at=%s, updated_at=%s
				 WHERE cart_id=%s AND status='active' AND converted_order_id IS NULL",
				$now, $now, $cart_id ) );

			if ( 1 !== (int) $affected ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $cart_id, 'race_lost_or_changed' );
				continue;
			}
			$out['abandoned']++;

			// --- 4) Eventas — VIENAS kartas, consent NETIKRINAMAS ---
			$payload = self::build_payload( $row, $valid );
			/* S1675: BE EL. PASTO EVENTO NEBEKELIAM.
			   Sender atmeta tokia uzklausa (validation: subscriber must contain
			   at least one of: id, email, or phone), irasas mirdavo `dead`, o
			   sargas siusdavo laiska. Svecio krepselis be adreso nera gedimas —
			   nera kam siusti. Krepselis vis tiek pazymimas `abandoned`
			   (statistika islieka), tik i ESP nekeliaujam.
			   Kiti emiteriai (order_paid, order_shipped) taip elgiasi nuo pradziu. */
			if ( $row['email'] ) {
				$em = Petshop_Event_Registry::emit(
					'cart_abandoned',
					$row['email'],
					$payload,
					array( 'event_id' => 'cart_abandoned_' . $cart_id )
				);
				if ( ! empty( $em['ok'] ) || ! isset( $em['ok'] ) ) { $out['events']++; }
			}

			// --- 5/6) Job TIK jei yra gavejas. Consent tikrina DISPATCH. ---
			if ( $row['email'] && class_exists( 'Petshop_Email_Dispatch' ) ) {
				$res = Petshop_Email_Dispatch::enqueue(
					'cart_abandoned',
					$row['email'],
					$payload,
					array(
						'job_key' => 'cart_abandoned:' . $cart_id . ':stage1',
						'user_id' => $row['user_id'] ? (int) $row['user_id'] : null,
						'context' => array( 'cart_id' => $cart_id ),
					)
				);
				if ( ! empty( $res['ok'] ) ) { $out['jobs']++; }
			} else {
				$out['no_email']++;
			}

			$out['details'][] = array(
				'cart_id' => $cart_id, 'action' => 'ABANDONED',
				'items' => count( $valid ), 'email' => $row['email'] ? 'yra' : 'nera',
			);
		}

		// --- 7) Senesni nei 7 d. -> expired, BE evento ---
		if ( ! $dry_run ) {
			$out['expired'] = (int) $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare(
				"UPDATE $T SET status='expired', status_changed_at=%s, updated_at=%s
				 WHERE status='active' AND converted_order_id IS NULL
				   AND ( last_cart_activity_at IS NULL OR last_cart_activity_at < %s )",
				$now, $now, $floor ) );
		} else {
			$out['expired'] = (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare(
				"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $T WHERE status='active' AND converted_order_id IS NULL
				   AND ( last_cart_activity_at IS NULL OR last_cart_activity_at < %s )", $floor ) );
		}

		return $out;
	}

	/**
	 * Palieka tik tas prekes, kurios REALIAI dar perkamos.
	 */
	protected static function valid_items( $items ) {
		$ok = array();
		foreach ( (array) $items as $i ) {
			$pid = ! empty( $i['variation_id'] ) ? (int) $i['variation_id'] : (int) $i['product_id'];
			if ( ! $pid ) { continue; }
			$p = wc_get_product( $pid );
			if ( ! $p || ! $p->is_purchasable() || ! $p->is_in_stock() ) { continue; }
			$base = (int) $i['product_id'];
			if ( $base && 'publish' !== get_post_status( $base ) ) { continue; }
			$i['_price'] = (float) wc_get_price_to_display( $p );
			$i['_name']  = $p->get_name();
			$ok[] = $i;
		}
		return $ok;
	}

	protected static function build_payload( $row, $valid ) {
		$items = array();
		$total = 0.0;
		foreach ( $valid as $i ) {
			$qty  = (float) $i['quantity'];
			$line = (float) $i['_price'] * $qty;
			$total += $line;
			$items[] = array(
				'product_id'   => (int) $i['product_id'],
				'variation_id' => (int) $i['variation_id'],
				'quantity'     => $qty,
				'name'         => (string) $i['_name'],
				'price'        => round( (float) $i['_price'], 2 ),
			);
		}
		return array(
			'cart_id'          => (string) $row['cart_id'],
			'cart_total'       => round( $total, 2 ),
			'cart_currency'    => 'EUR',
			'cart_items'       => $items,
			'last_activity_at' => gmdate( 'c', strtotime( $row['last_cart_activity_at'] ) ),
		);
	}


	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
	/* STAGE 2 (+24 val.)                                                 */
	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

	/** Po kiek laiko nuo stage1 issiuntimo */
	const STAGE2_AFTER = 86400; // 24 val.

	/**
	 * Antras apleisto krepselio laiskas.
	 *
	 * TZ §4.4.2 kryzmine taisykle: daugiapakopiai srautai tikrinami PRIES
	 * KIEKVIENA siuntima, ne tik trigerio momentu.
	 *
	 * SALYGOS (visos privalomos):
	 *   stage1 job'as yra ir jo status = 'sent'
	 *   nuo stage1 issiuntimo praejo >= 24 val.
	 *   stage2 job'o DAR NERA
	 *   krepselio status vis dar 'abandoned' (ne converted / expired)
	 *   converted_order_id NERA
	 *   bent viena preke vis dar realiai perkama
	 *
	 * consent ir marketing suppression tikrina DISPATCH (kaip ir stage1).
	 *
	 * TOKENAS: jei stage1 recovery tokenas VIS DAR GALIOJA — naudojam TA PATI.
	 * Tai tas pats krepselis ir tas pats veiksmas; antras tokenas butu
	 * antra galiojanti nuoroda be reikalo.
	 */
	public static function detect_stage2( $dry_run = false ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$T  = Petshop_Cart_Tracker::table();
		$EJ = $wpdb->prefix . 'ps_email_jobs';

		$cutoff = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - self::STAGE2_AFTER );
		$out = array(
			'dry_run' => (bool) $dry_run, 'cutoff' => $cutoff,
			'candidates' => 0, 'queued' => 0, 'skipped' => array(), 'details' => array(),
		);

		// stage1 issiusti job'ai, kuriems stage2 dar nera
		$rows = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.job_key, j.recipient_email, j.recipient_user_id,
			        j.payload, j.context_json, j.sent_at
			   FROM $EJ j
			  WHERE j.flow = 'cart_abandoned'
			    AND j.status = 'sent'
			    AND j.sent_at IS NOT NULL
			    AND j.sent_at <= %s
			    AND NOT EXISTS (
			        SELECT 1 FROM $EJ j2
			         WHERE j2.flow = 'cart_abandoned_2'
			           AND j2.job_key = CONCAT(
			               SUBSTRING_INDEX( j.job_key, ':stage1', 1 ), ':stage2' )
			    )
			  ORDER BY j.sent_at ASC LIMIT %d", $cutoff, self::BATCH ), ARRAY_A );

		$out['candidates'] = count( (array) $rows );

		foreach ( (array) $rows as $j ) {
			$ctx = json_decode( (string) $j['context_json'], true );
			if ( ! is_array( $ctx ) ) { $ctx = array(); }
			$cart_id = isset( $ctx['cart_id'] ) ? $ctx['cart_id'] : '';
			if ( ! $cart_id ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $j['job_key'], 'no_cart_id' );
				continue;
			}

			$cart = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare(
				"SELECT * FROM $T WHERE cart_id=%s LIMIT 1", $cart_id ), ARRAY_A );
			if ( ! $cart ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $cart_id, 'cart_gone' );
				continue;
			}
			// Uzsakymas ivyko arba krepselis atkurtas/uzdarytas
			if ( ! empty( $cart['converted_order_id'] ) ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $cart_id, 'converted' );
				continue;
			}
			if ( 'abandoned' !== $cart['status'] ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $cart_id, 'status_' . $cart['status'] );
				continue;
			}

			// Bent viena preke vis dar perkama — tikrinam SIANDIEN
			$items = json_decode( (string) $cart['snapshot_json'], true );
			$valid = self::valid_items( is_array( $items ) ? $items : array() );
			if ( ! $valid ) {
				$out['skipped'][] = array( $cart_id, 'no_valid_products' );
				continue;
			}

			if ( $dry_run ) {
				$out['details'][] = array( 'cart_id' => $cart_id, 'action' => 'WOULD_QUEUE', 'items' => count( $valid ) );
				continue;
			}

			$payload = self::build_payload( $cart, $valid );

			// TOKENO PAKARTOTINIS NAUDOJIMAS
			$ctx2 = array( 'cart_id' => $cart_id );
			if ( ! empty( $ctx['recovery_url'] ) && self::token_still_valid( $ctx['recovery_url'] ) ) {
				$ctx2['recovery_url']   = $ctx['recovery_url'];
				$ctx2['token_reused']   = 1;
			}

			$res = Petshop_Email_Dispatch::enqueue(
				'cart_abandoned_2',
				$j['recipient_email'],
				$payload,
				array(
					'job_key' => 'cart_abandoned:' . $cart_id . ':stage2',
					'user_id' => ! empty( $j['recipient_user_id'] ) ? (int) $j['recipient_user_id'] : null,
					'context' => $ctx2,
				)
			);
			if ( ! empty( $res['ok'] ) && empty( $res['duplicate'] ) ) { $out['queued']++; }
			$out['details'][] = array(
				'cart_id' => $cart_id, 'action' => 'QUEUED',
				'token_reused' => isset( $ctx2['token_reused'] ) ? 1 : 0,
				'items' => count( $valid ),
			);
		}
		return $out;
	}

	/**
	 * Ar recovery tokenas is stage1 vis dar galioja (peek — NIEKO nekeicia).
	 */
	protected static function token_still_valid( $url ) {
		if ( ! class_exists( 'Petshop_Action_Tokens' ) ) { return false; }
		$q = wp_parse_url( $url, PHP_URL_QUERY );
		if ( ! $q ) { return false; }
		parse_str( $q, $p );
		if ( empty( $p['t'] ) ) { return false; }
		$peek = Petshop_Action_Tokens::peek( $p['t'] );
		return ! empty( $peek['valid'] );
	}

	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
	/* Konversija                                                         */
	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

	/**
	 * Uzsakymas sukurtas -> krepselis konvertavo.
	 * Veikia ir tada, kai krepselis JAU pazymetas abandoned (uzsakymas atejo veliau):
	 * eventas jau ivyko, bet job'as dispatch etape gaus converted_before_send.
	 */
	public static function on_order_created( $order_id ) {
		global $wpdb;
		if ( ! $order_id || ! class_exists( 'Petshop_Cart_Tracker' ) ) { return; }
		$cart_id = Petshop_Cart_Tracker::get_cart_id( false );
		if ( ! $cart_id ) { return; }
		$T = Petshop_Cart_Tracker::table();
		$now = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare(
			"UPDATE $T SET status='converted', converted_order_id=%d, status_changed_at=%s, updated_at=%s
			 WHERE cart_id=%s AND ( converted_order_id IS NULL OR converted_order_id=0 )",
			(int) $order_id, $now, $now, $cart_id ) );
	}

	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
	/* Pirmas paleidimas                                                  */
	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

	/**
	 * Vienkartinis: visi ISTORINIAI seni active irasai -> expired,
	 * kad pirmas cron nesukeltu retrospektyvines eventu ir laisku lavinos.
	 */
	public static function maybe_seed_expired() {
		if ( get_option( 'petshop_cart_abandon_seeded' ) ) { return array( 'seeded' => 'jau' ); }
		global $wpdb;
		$T = Petshop_Cart_Tracker::table();
		$now   = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		$floor = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - ( self::MAX_AGE_DAYS * DAY_IN_SECONDS ) );
		$n = (int) $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare(
			"UPDATE $T SET status='expired', status_changed_at=%s, updated_at=%s
			 WHERE status='active' AND converted_order_id IS NULL
			   AND ( last_cart_activity_at IS NULL OR last_cart_activity_at < %s )",
			$now, $now, $floor ) );
		update_option( 'petshop_cart_abandon_seeded', current_time( 'mysql', true ), false );
		return array( 'seeded' => $n );
	}

	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
	/* Cron                                                               */
	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

	public static function init() {
		add_action( 'woocommerce_checkout_order_processed',            array( __CLASS__, 'on_order_created' ), 10, 1 );
		add_action( 'woocommerce_store_api_checkout_order_processed',  array( __CLASS__, 'on_store_api_order' ), 10, 1 );

		add_action( 'ps_cart_abandon_check', array( __CLASS__, 'cron_run' ) );
		if ( ! wp_next_scheduled( 'ps_cart_abandon_check' ) ) {
			wp_schedule_event( time() + 300, 'ps_esp_5min', 'ps_cart_abandon_check' );
		}
	}

	public static function on_store_api_order( $order ) {
		$id = is_object( $order ) && method_exists( $order, 'get_id' ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order;
		self::on_order_created( $id );
	}

	public static function cron_run() {
		self::maybe_seed_expired();
		self::detect( false );
		self::detect_stage2( false );
	}

	public static function stats() {
		global $wpdb; $T = Petshop_Cart_Tracker::table();
		return array(
			'by_status' => $wpdb->get_results( "SELECT status, COUNT(*) c FROM $T GROUP BY status", ARRAY_A ),
			'seeded'    => get_option( 'petshop_cart_abandon_seeded' ),
		);
	}
}
